crossRefs.note: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.

For he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, Yahweh saw the earth;
for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.
Israel will be saved by Yahweh with an everlasting salvation. You will not be disappointed nor confounded to ages…

They sang to one another in praising and giving thanks to Yahweh, “For he is good, for his loving kindness endures…

translations.web: Don’t let the oppressed return ashamed. Let the poor and needy praise your name.
translations.bsb: Do not let the oppressed retreat in shame; may the poor and needy praise Your name.
translations.kjv: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise thy name.
translations.asv: Oh let not the oppressed return ashamed: Let the poor and needy praise thy name.
